definitions.short: Jigal , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H3008. Yigal יִגְאָל proper name, masculine ( He redeems ) — 1 one of the spies Num 13:7 . 2 one of David's heroes 2Sam 23:36 . 3 descendant of Zerubbabel 1Chr 3:22 .

occurrences.englishText: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
